seo.title: Blake Ward — Sculptor
seo.description: Blake Ward, sculptor. Four decades of figurative work exhibited across thirteen countries and three continents.

content.alt: Portrait of the sculptor Blake Ward

body.text: “Inspired by the grace and symmetry of classical realism, my work explores an irresistible alchemy of sensuality and sentiment — a form of beauty sometimes distorted by our demons, and other times enchanted by all that is pure within our souls.”

body.text: Blake William Ward born in Yellowknife, Northwest Territories, Canada, on June 3, 1956, and raised in Edmonton.
body.html: Blake William Ward born in Yellowknife, Northwest Territories, Canada, on June 3, 1956, and raised in Edmonton.

body.text: Holding to his appreciation of the human figure, Ward remains true to the representational quality and realistic proportions of traditional sculpture while continually finding new ways to comment on the human condition.
body.html: Holding to his appreciation of the human figure, Ward remains true to the representational quality and realistic proportions of traditional sculpture while continually finding new ways to comment on the human condition.

body.text: Exhibitions of his work have travelled across three continents North America, Europe and Asia from Monte-Carlo and Paris to Singapore, Hong Kong and India.
body.html: Exhibitions of his work have travelled across three continents North America, Europe and Asia from Monte-Carlo and Paris to Singapore, Hong Kong and India.

body.text: Receives an Honours Degree in Fine Art from the University of Alberta.
body.html: Receives an Honours Degree in Fine Art from the University of Alberta.

body.text: Moves to Paris to study figurative sculpture under Cyril Heck.
body.html: Moves to Paris to study figurative sculpture under Cyril Heck.

body.text: Relocates to Monaco and opens his Monte-Carlo studio, close to his foundry and marble quarry.
body.html: Relocates to Monaco and opens his Monte-Carlo studio, close to his foundry and marble quarry.

body.text: Known for a traditional, academic figurative style exploring notions of idealised beauty.
body.html: Known for a traditional, academic figurative style exploring notions of idealised beauty.

body.text: The Fragments Collection the artist deliberately “de-sculpts” the figure, alluding to the destructive nature of our civilization.
body.html: The Fragments Collection the artist deliberately “de-sculpts” the figure, alluding to the destructive nature of our civilization.

body.text: The Re-Think Collection, dedicated to the promotion of human rights.
body.html: The Re-Think Collection, dedicated to the promotion of human rights.

body.text: The Spirits Collection embracing negative space, crossing into the abstract and ethereal with exposed interior landscapes.
body.html: The Spirits Collection embracing negative space, crossing into the abstract and ethereal with exposed interior landscapes.

body.text: The Andromeda Collection broadens the Spirit Collection through the use of 3D printing.
body.html: The Andromeda Collection broadens the Spirit Collection through the use of 3D printing.
